entries.reason: The stream and event metadata have a typed Protobuf binary representation instead of requiring a Value-mediated JSON snapshot.
entries.schema: game_event:stream version 3 is GameEventStreamSave with ordered GameEventRecord entries and domain-owned payload_wire bytes.
entries.version: Binary writers emit version 3; the existing JSON restore keeps versions 1 and 2 readable.
entries.migration: Legacy JSON can be restored before recapturing as version 3 binary; stream identity, sequence and metadata remain typed.
entries.unknown_fields: Binary restore rejects unknown root and record fields; all required record fields and causal reference tags are checked.
entries.restore_atomicity: Every record is parsed into an independent deque before the live stream and cursors are replaced.

entries.reason: The event stream exposes typed binary persistence alongside its existing script and compatibility JSON boundary.

trim.absent_profile: No L1-L4 trim claim is made for this change.

entries.thread_affinity: Snapshot and restore run on the stream owner thread and invoke no callbacks.
cost_notes: Binary save and restore cost linear time in retained records and payload bytes per snapshot.
